summary: Comprehensive testing of BRUNO Chat/Messaging feature. Backend: 24/24 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working - Chat list, Chat view, Send messages, New chat modal with user search.

ui_bugs.issue: Send button click intercepted by 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay at bottom-right. Workaround: Use Enter key to send messages or force=True in Playwright

critical_code_review_comments: User search API correctly excludes current user and supports name/email search
Chat creation properly checks for existing direct chats to avoid duplicates
Messages API correctly enriches responses with sender info (username, avatar_url)
ChatPage.jsx uses polling (5s for messages, 10s for chat list) for real-time updates
NewChatModal implements debounced search (300ms) for better UX
Message attachments properly support image and video types
Chat list shows last message preview and unread count
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
seed_data_creation: Created test user 2 (chattest2@bruno.com) for chat testing. Test messages prefixed with TEST_ for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat feature fully tested and working. Two test users available for chat testing. Backend tests cover: user search (by name/email), create/get chat, get chats list, send/get messages, message with attachments, conversation flow. Frontend tests cover: login, chat page load, chat list display, chat selection, message input, send message, new chat modal, user search in modal.

user_search_api.details: Search by name and email works. Excludes current user. Requires minimum 2 characters. Returns user info with avatar and display_name.

create_get_chat_api.details: Creates new direct chat or returns existing one. Cannot create chat with self. Requires authentication.

get_chats_list_api.details: Returns user's chats sorted by last_message_at. Enriches with other_participants info, last_message, and unread_count.

get_messages_api.details: Returns messages in chronological order. Enriches with sender info. Marks messages as read. Requires participant access.

send_message_api.details: Sends text messages and messages with attachments. Updates chat's last_message. Creates notifications for other participants.

chat_page_ui.details: Two-column layout with chat list and chat view. Responsive design (mobile/desktop). Shows 'Mensajes' header with + button.

chat_list_component.details: Shows chat items with avatar, name, last message preview, timestamp, and unread count. Selectable with highlight.

chat_view_component.details: Shows chat header with participant info and online status. Messages grouped by date with proper styling (sent/received). Input with send button, image upload, and mic.

new_chat_modal.details: Modal with 'Nueva conversación' title. Search input with 'Buscar usuario por nombre o email...' placeholder. Shows search results with avatar and username. Cancelar button to close.

test_modules: Authentication (2 tests) - login user 1 and user 2
User Search API (5 tests) - search by name, email, excludes self, minimum chars, unauthorized
Create/Get Chat API (4 tests) - create chat, get existing, cannot chat self, unauthorized
Get Chats List API (3 tests) - get list user 1, get list user 2, unauthorized
Send Message API (4 tests) - send text, send with attachment, nonexistent chat, unauthorized
Get Messages API (4 tests) - get messages, get as receiver, nonexistent chat, unauthorized
Conversation Flow (1 test) - full back-and-forth between two users

tests_performed: Chat page unauthenticated - shows login prompt
Chat page authenticated - shows chat list with existing chats
Select chat - displays chat view with messages
Send message - input clears and message appears
New chat modal - opens on + click, search works, results display
